_metadata.purpose: Content labels written to contentFlags on imported hints, for a possible future family-friendly setting (owner 2026-10-21). Labels do NOT hold, filter or hide anything; no setting exists. The existing COKE flag 'not-family-friendly' is separate and unchanged.
_metadata.how: A label applies when its pattern matches the hint text, either per-word line, or a pair word (uppercase, whole words). Patterns are deliberately narrow (no SMOKE, TOAST, SPIRIT, BLOOD, WAR or DEATH on their own) and keyword-based: a reviewer should still read the labelled list (labelled.csv) before any filter uses it.
_metadata.scope: consolidated-1022 hints only; earlier library hints are not labelled
